legal_privacy_data_collected_text: We collect information you provide directly and data generated automatically:

legal_privacy_usage_text: We use data to provide and improve the service, personalize content by city, send notifications, process payments, communicate with you, and analyze usage trends. We do not sell your personal data.
legal_privacy_sharing_text: We share data only with: service providers (hosting, analytics, payments) under contract; legal authorities when required by law; business partners with your consent; and in aggregated, anonymized form.
legal_privacy_ads_text: We use privacy-respecting analytics (no personal identifiers). Third-party advertisers may use cookies for measurement. You can opt out via browser settings. Google AdSense may serve personalized ads based on browsing behavior.

legal_privacy_rights_text: You may access, correct, delete, or export your personal data. You can object to processing or request restriction. Contact us at privacy@bigendabite.com. We respond within 30 days.
legal_privacy_retention_text: We retain account data while your account is active. Inactive accounts are deleted after 2 years. Analytics data is retained for 13 months. Payment records are kept per financial regulations.
legal_privacy_children_text: Bigenda Bite is not directed to children under 13. We do not knowingly collect data from children. If you believe we have, contact us to delete it.
legal_privacy_changes_text: We may update this policy. Changes are posted here with a new effective date. Material changes are communicated via email or in-app notice.
legal_privacy_contact_text: Questions about this policy? Email privacy@bigendabite.com or use our Contact page.
about_intro: Bigenda Bite is your everyday guide to life and administrative processes in Rwanda. Built with care for Rwandans, by Rwandans.
about_mission_text: To make official information accessible, trustworthy, and easy to follow — so anyone in Rwanda can get things done without confusion or delay.
about_team_text: We are a small team of Rwandan developers, writers, and researchers who believe good information changes lives. We work with government sources, community contributors, and local experts.
about_approach_text: Every process and guide is verified against official sources. We prioritize accuracy over speed, and clarity over completeness. Community tips add real-world context that official sources miss.
about_content_text: Official Processes — Government procedures with steps, fees, and documents. How-To Guides — Practical advice for daily life. Business Directory — Verified local vendors. Alerts — Time-sensitive official announcements.
about_tech_text: Built with Next.js, TypeScript, MongoDB, and Sanity CMS. Hosted on Vercel. Payments via MTN MoMo. Automated scraping with human review keeps content current.
about_contact_text: We're always looking to improve. Email us at hello@bigendabite.com or visit our Contact page.

contact_faq_response: How long until I get a reply?
contact_faq_response_text: We typically respond within 1-2 business days. Urgent issues are prioritized.
contact_faq_business: How do I list my business?
contact_faq_business_text: Visit the Membership page to choose a plan. Basic is free; Pro adds lead capture and analytics.
contact_faq_content: How do I report incorrect information?
contact_faq_content_text: Use the "Suggest Edit" button on any process or guide page, or use the contact form with subject "Content Correction."
contact_faq_advertising: Can I advertise on Bigenda Bite?
contact_faq_advertising_text: Yes, we offer sponsored placements in the directory and homepage. Select "Advertising" in the contact form to learn more.
